notes: Reference date 2018-03-12. Every saved policy carries an effective date on or before the reference date (version notes), and each is the version identified as in force on 2018-03-12. ACA.FG.300.015 (2018_01) was effective 2018-03-08, four days before the reference date; its live copy may contain edits after the reference date (directory shows a 2024-02-05 change), so c11 carries version_uncertain.

2018_00_link is a policy-directory page for HRO.BE.600.030 (no policy text of its own; names Mississippi Code section 25-3-95). 2018_07 (Leave Guidelines) covers accrual timing and department-head duties only; no provision for a parent, no component.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave appears in any saved document. Pay during a birth comes only from the employee's own accrued major medical (sick) leave: up to six weeks of it may be used for a birth or placement (c3 for nine-month faculty, c5 for twelve-month employees), counted 0 paid weeks under R1/R1b. A nine-month faculty member accrues 119.97 hours (about 3 weeks) of sick leave a year in the first three years, unlimited accumulation.

Population: most tenure-stream faculty hold nine-month appointments; the nine-month policy (2018_03) is coded main_campus_tenure_stream. The twelve-month policy (2018_04) is for 'Twelve-month permanent full-time employees' and is recorded by name (schema 2b). The nine-month policy says 'Eligibility for use of leave is the same as staff employees', so the twelve-month policy's eligibility terms (own or family condition, physician certification beyond 32 hours) are cited for c2; its unpaid leave to accompany disability sick leave (c6) is not stated in the nine-month policy and stays with the twelve-month group.

Nine-month restriction (coded in c2 and c3 time_window): a nine-month faculty member with a condition, or an FMLA event, between the end of one academic year and the beginning of the next is not eligible for paid-leave status (2018_03; 2018_05).
FMLA guidelines: employer continues the employee's share of health insurance during the leave (not a component); intermittent leave for birth or placement only if the University agrees.

Tenure clock: the general one-year extension for personal circumstances (c9) is discretionary and general-purpose (non-exclusive list including a death in the family, U1); the parent-specific exception (c10), 'may choose to take a one-year extension ... for each child, up to a maximum of two years', is coded guaranteed_on_request with an ambiguous flag (the request still passes to the Chancellor for final action).

Chain, birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks (c1) from the birth, with up to 6 weeks of own major medical (sick) leave for the birth (c3) inside it (c1 concurrent_with c3); further own sick leave (c2) and, after balances are exhausted, donated leave for a catastrophic condition only (c12, consecutive_after c2); discretionary leave without pay (c7, general purpose) and requested workload flexibility (c11, also_available with c1, discretionary, general purpose).

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA 12 weeks (c1), with up to 6 weeks of own major medical (sick) leave for the birth (c3) inside it; c11 also_available with c1 on request. Dual University employees share one 12-week FMLA period for a birth.

Cited but not saved: Personal Leave (vacation) for Twelve-Month Employees policy (named in 2018_04); Mississippi Code section 25-3-95 (named on 2018_00); the University's policies on Personal (vacation) leave (named in 2018_07); Board of Trustees bylaws and policy (named in 2018_02, not leave-related); forms HR Form 3, Form 17, Form 21 (forms, not policy).
calendar: the documents describe semesters ('semester-by-semester', 'each fall semester', 'At the end of each spring semester') without a length; term_weeks is the semester default (R8).
